lead.headline: Bad things man bad things buries Poochinski early
lead.dek: 181.84 and nobody left to play. Poochinski sits at 98.6 with three starters to go and a live projection of 133.99. The first-place game is over before the late window opens.
lead.pull: Poochinski’s live win odds: 0%. Three starters left, and none of them can fix this.
body: This morning the first-place game was a lean. By 1:48 PM it was a forwarding address. Bad things man bad things finished its day at 181.84 with every starter done, and the scoring came from everywhere: Kirk Cousins 28.18, Michael Wilson 26.8, Chuba Hubbard 24.9, Matthew Golden 20.9, Trey McBride 20.2, James Cook III 18.1. Six starters at 18.1 or better. That isn’t a lineup. That’s a firing squad.

Poochinski brought the Dallas stack and the Dallas stack brought a shrug. Dak Prescott 19.8, CeeDee Lamb 12.8, Javonte Williams 6.7, Brandon Aubrey 12.0. Jahmyr Gibbs did his part with 24.8 and Chase Brown chipped in 16.0. The 6:19 a.m. pickup, Chris Godwin Jr., is final at 0.0.

What’s left for Poochinski: Caleb Williams, Luther Burden III and the Seattle Seahawks D/ST, all yet to play. Even if all three hit their projections, the live math lands at 133.99. Bad things man bad things already has 181.84. The live odds give Poochinski 0%.

The CeeDee Lamb call this morning was the right one on paper. The paper just didn’t score. Poochinski walked into Sunday at 6-1 with the league’s best record; it walks out with a second loss and company at the top. Bad things man bad things, 5-2 this morning, gets to say it beat first place with a full day’s work done before the late games kicked off.
Next update after the late games, when AB81 finally gets to play.

quick_hits.headline: AB81 has 20.58 and eight starters left
quick_hits.body: Maye I touch your TDs? leads 98.0 to 20.58, but AB81’s Sam Darnold, Jaxon Smith-Njigba, Dallas Goedert and the Philadelphia Eagles D/ST haven’t played, and Matthew Stafford, Kyren Williams and Rhamondre Stevenson are on the field now. The champ has two left, Drake Maye and Omarion Hampton. Live projection: 124.6 to 120.3, 56.2% Maye I touch your TDs?.

quick_hits.headline: AB81’s two open spots are still open
quick_hits.body: Mike Evans (bye) and DeVonta Smith (Out) are both still in the lineup, and nothing on the bench fits. The answer would have to come off the wire, and the late games are the last window. In a game projected at 124.6 to 120.3, one body matters.

quick_hits.headline: Cherry Blossom flips the closest game
quick_hits.body: This morning’s coin flip is now 89.8% Cherry Blossom. Tee Higgins went for 37.5, Brock Bowers 28.2, and Jameson Williams rewarded the flex call with 17.0 while Parker Washington sat at 3.6. It’s 152.24 to 122.8, with Jonah Coleman, Puka Nacua and Travis Kelce still playing; deeboliciouskins needs Jayden Daniels, D’Andre Swift and Jason Myers to cover a live projection of 190.42 to 163.06.

quick_hits.body: Chris Godwin Jr. (Poochinski, 6:19 a.m.): 0.0, final. Hunter Henry (Santa Clara’s Finest, 6:23 a.m.): 4.6 and playing. Jonah Coleman (Cherry Blossom, 9:36 PM Saturday): 3.1 and playing. Stefon Diggs (Santa Clara’s Finest, 6:20 a.m.): yet to play.
